scope: Original GPR LRCPC2 and SIMD B/H/S/D/Q LRCPC3 LDAPUR/STLUR instructions, RCpc acquire/release ordering and access-EL checked address addition. Model qualification is sequential, naturally aligned, Normal WB/nonoverflow explicit IR, image-context runtime parameters and initialized-image rebasing. No full arm64e or Apple CPTA-on claim.
llvm_dependency_policy: Recorded NeverSight LLVM fork with accepted r6 prebuilt lag; no patches, overlays or r7 release in this change.

primary_arm_reference.role: Primary Arm LDNP/LDP/LDPSW operation reference; no pseudocode copied into implementation.

retained_model_refusals.reason: The mandatory LRCPC3 feature check read level2 and refused before generated-code execution.

analysis.conclusion: The generated original ordered halfword access at an odd address faults before completion. Successful matrix inputs must make effective ordered access addresses naturally aligned. Unaligned/fault qualification remains separate.

retained_test_build_error.reason: The first alignment guard test used an undeclared V1 name; corrected to the declared V(index) mapping before qualification.

not_run_in_this_round.reason: The unchanged scalar register-offset source matrix was fully exercised in the prior pair qualification, not counted as passed in this selected round.
The unchanged slow source ABI matrix was fully exercised in the prior pair qualification, not counted as passed in this selected round.

unqualified: Unaligned/fault outcome matrix and original exception-PC/syndrome identity
ci_diagnostics: Required Code Review tool still requests a GitHub connection; no Actions CLI/REST/browser fallback used.

parity_qualification.initial_failure: The existing randomized sweep allowed UnliftedInstruction to abort on constrained-unpredictable STRH writeback overlap. Typed refusal outcomes now remain distinct from successful lifts; one-sided refusal mismatches and unrelated exceptions are checked.
